scenes.vo: Every night at eleven, my smart speaker says, goodnight, Riya. I live alone. My name isn't Riya.
scenes.cap: Every night at 11: "Goodnight, Riya." I live alone.

scenes.vo: I checked the app. No routine. No alarm. Just a voice command, every night, at eleven. From inside the flat.
scenes.cap: No routine. A voice command. From inside the flat.

scenes.vo: I reset it. Unplugged it for a week. The first night I plugged it back in, it said, welcome back, Riya.
scenes.cap: I reset it. Plugged it back in: "Welcome back, Riya."

scenes.vo: So I asked it. Who is Riya? It said, Riya is the one who lives here.
scenes.cap: "Who is Riya?" "Riya is the one who lives here."

scenes.vo: Then, who am I? It paused. Then it said, you're the guest. She's been waiting for you to leave.
I didn't sleep. At eleven, the light on the speaker turned blue. And from the bedroom behind me, someone whispered, goodnight, Riya.
